newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill rule won't deter foreigners - banker.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill rule won't deter foreigners - banker.

text.p: A new rule requiring non-resident Treasury bill deals in Ukraine to be registered at the central bank will not chase foreigners away from the market, a Western banker said on Thursday.
"I don't think it will stop people taking part. It's a very lucrative market," said the banker, who asked not to be named.
Commercial banks received an instruction from the National Bank of Ukraine on Thursday saying all non-resident T-bill deals must be registered within three days after they were signed.
The new rule would apply from February 25 and existing agreements had to be registered before then.
The banker said the move appeared to fall in line with a law which came into force in the middle of last year and required foreign investment to be registered within three days.
"Until now it was unclear whether non-resident T-bill deals also had to be registered," the banker said.
